turns.text: The tear feels healed. I sometimes leak a little when I cough.

turns.speaker: Dr Orin Lark
turns.text: The examination shows that the repair has healed. Pelvic health physiotherapy can help with coordination and strength.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen

turns.text: We discussed contraception because ovulation can return before the first period. You plan to use condoms.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
